title: ManageContractCatalogue
description: Every request and response shape the desktop clients consume.

AiGatewayConfig.description: AI Gateway 顶层配置，对应 config.toml 中 `[aiGateway]` 段。

codexVisibleModels.description:
Codex App 前端模型选择器可见的模型列表。

该列表只控制 `/models` 暴露给 Codex App 的 catalog 模型，不参与上游 provider 路由。

customModels.description:
用户自定义的模型目录条目。

内置 `models.json` 之外的新模型在这里声明后即可被 `codexVisibleModels`
选中；没声明、但被某个 provider 的 `models` 列表覆盖的模型名，也会按该
provider 的协议家族自动合成一个保守的目录条目。

defaultProvider.description: 兼容旧配置的遗留字段；路由不使用默认/兜底 provider。

filterImageGenerationTool.description: 是否过滤 Codex 请求中的 image_generation tool。

modelOwners.description:
同名模型由多个 provider 声明时的归属：Codex 侧模型名 → provider 名称。

未配置的模型继续按权重 + 会话粘性选路；配置了但对应 provider 不可用
（被禁用、被删除或不再声明该模型）时自动回落到默认选路。

promptCacheRetention.description: 全局 prompt_cache_retention 值（如 "1h"），可选。

providerDisplayPrefix.description:
是否用服务商名给模型加显示前缀（`AutoClaw · GLM-5.3-Flash`）。

前缀跟随 provider 的 `name`；没有逐服务商覆盖。

requestLogDetailsEnabled.description: 是否记录请求/响应/SSE 详情。关闭时仍保留摘要指标。

requestLogMaxMb.description:
请求日志库体积上限（MB）；0 表示不按体积限制。

超过上限时按时间从旧到新删除，直到回落到上限以内，避免长期运行后
数据库无界膨胀。

requestLogRetentionDays.description:
请求日志保留天数；0 表示不自动清理。

请求日志库会随使用持续增长（实测数周可达数十 MB）。daemon 会定期删除
早于该天数的记录并回收空间；设 0 可关闭自动清理、完全手动管理。

requestLoggingEnabled.description: 是否启用请求日志记录。

sub2apiAdmin.description:
Optional read-only connection to a Sub2API administration API. This is
deliberately separate from provider API keys: it reads the upstream
account pool instead of authorizing model requests.

CodexProviderMode.description:
Which process currently owns Codex's provider routing.

`direct-api` means Codex calls the selected third-party API provider
directly, without going through MochiPort's local gateway.

CustomModelConfig.description:
用户自定义的模型目录条目。

只描述“这个模型是什么”；Codex 依赖的协议字段（`comp_hash`、
`apply_patch_tool_type`、`use_responses_lite`、`shell_type`、推理等级等）
由 `family` 或所属 provider 的协议家族模板补齐。

contextWindow.description: 上下文窗口（token）；为空时继承家族模板。

description.description: 说明文案；为空时用协议家族的默认说明。

displayName.description: 前端显示名；为空时用 slug。

family.description: 显式覆盖的协议家族；为空时按所属 provider 的类型推断。

providerName.description: 提供该模型的服务商名称；为空时按各 provider 的 `models` 列表推断。

slug.description: 模型名（同时是 `/models` 返回的 slug 与路由匹配名）。

supportsImageInput.description: 是否接受图片输入；默认 false（保守）。

DiscoveredModel.description:
上游 `/models` 发现到的单个模型元数据。

字段全部可选：只有上游明确声明的信息才落库，避免把猜测当成能力。

contextWindow.description: 上游声明的上下文窗口。

supportsImageInput.description: 上游明确声明的图片输入能力。

leaseGeneration.description:
New clients send the lease generation to fence a restart request if
ownership changes while existing work drains. It stays optional so
older GUI clients remain compatible.

state.description:
The daemon reports an active lease without exposing the management
credential. Clients compare `installationId` with their own identity.

ModelFamily.description: 协议家族：决定自动合成目录条目时继承哪一套能力模板。

compatibility.description: provider 兼容 profile。Anthropic Messages 兼容厂商优先使用该字段表达差异。

discoveredModels.description:
从上游 `/models` 自动发现到的模型元数据。

只用于给「目录之外的模型名」补齐显示名、上下文窗口和图片能力；
上游没有明确声明时保守留空，不参与路由匹配。

modelAliases.description:
Codex 侧 model 到上游 provider model 的映射。

例如 `glm-5.2 = "GLM-5.2"`。路由使用 key 匹配 Codex 请求，出站使用 value。

models.description: 该 provider 支持的 model 列表（精确匹配用）。

modelsUrl.description: 可选的模型列表 API URL。为空时 GUI 按 base_url 推导 `/models`。

providerType.description: provider 类型：OpenAI/DeepSeek/Grok Responses、Chat Completions 或 Anthropic Messages。

weight.description: 同一 model 命中多个 provider 时的路由权重。实际路由中最小按 1 处理。

oneOf.description: DeepSeek Responses API 原生透传。
Grok/xAI Responses API 透传，带 Grok 专用兼容处理。

pairingCode.description: 非空时启用配对码模式：未绑定私聊必须提供该码才会写入 allowedChatIds。

TelegramReplyGranularity.description:
Telegram 账号的回复颗粒度；档位按"消息包含哪些成分与形态"划分，
与 GUI 的「回复颗粒度」选择和 Telegram 内的 /回复 命令共享。

oneOf.description: 只发过程文本（助手说明）和最终结果；工具执行、文件修改等一律静默。
现有默认行为：所有信息合并进一条聚合气泡原地更新。
所有信息逐条独立发送：每条工具执行、文件修改各自一条消息，不合并更新。

customModels.description: 自定义模型条目；缺省表示保持现状（旧客户端不会带这个字段）。

modelOwners.description: 同名模型归属；缺省表示保持现状。

providerDisplayPrefix.description: 是否用服务商名给模型加显示前缀；缺省表示保持现状。

requestLogMaxMb.description: 请求日志库体积上限（MB）；缺省表示保持现状。

requestLogRetentionDays.description: 请求日志保留天数；缺省表示保持现状。

discoveredModels.description: 从上游 `/models` 发现到的模型元数据（可选）。

UsageBreakdownRow.description:
One row of the cross-product breakdown, keyed the same way as the client's
history database: `(day, service, source, model, project)`.

costUsd.description: Cost for this row, priced with its own model.

UsageHourEntry.description: Usage for one hour of one day, for the recent-activity series.

UsageMinuteBucket.description: Token totals for one minute of day.

minute.description: Minutes since the Unix epoch, so a 24-hour window can cross midnight.

costUsd.description:
API-equivalent estimate in US dollars. Mirrors the client calculation it
replaces: cached input is billed once, at the cached rate.

UsageQuotaHistoryPoint.description: One day's last observed percentage for one quota window.

kind.description:
`primary` or `secondary`, i.e. the record position rather than a fixed
duration (measured records carry a 30-day window under `primary`).

UsageQuotaSnapshot.description:
Latest quota windows. Absent entirely when the logs carried none, which is
the normal state for sessions routed through the AI gateway.

primary.description:
The record's `primary` window. Classify by `windowMinutes`, not by this
position: measured records carry a 30-day window here.

secondary.description:
The record's `secondary` window. Usually absent; classify by
`windowMinutes` for the same reason as `primary`.

UsageQuotaWindow.description: One quota window as reported by Codex.

resetsAtMs.description:
Absolute reset time, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch. Absent when
Codex reported a relative reset without a usable record timestamp.

usedPercent.description: Percentage of the window already consumed.

windowMinutes.description:
Window length in minutes, as reported by Codex. Callers should classify
windows by this rather than by `primary`/`secondary` position: measured
records carry a 30-day window under `primary`.

UsageSummaryResponse.description: Local Codex usage across the requested window.

breakdown.description: Cross-product rows, ordered by day, model, source, then project.

days.description: Newest day first; empty when no local Codex data was found.

estimatedCostUsd.description:
Estimated cost across the window, in US dollars. Summed per model so each
model's own rate applies.

`serde(default)` like the collections above: this field was added after the
first release of the endpoint, and a newer client must still be able to
decode an older daemon's response.

generatedAtMs.description: Milliseconds since the Unix epoch, so clients can label their snapshot.

hours.description: Newest hour first, for the recent-activity series.

minutes.description:
Per-minute totals over the trailing window the clients use (48 hours at
most), oldest minute first. Clients derive live rates (`tokensPerMinute`,
baseline) from these.

models.description:
Highest usage first. A session that switched models contributes to each
model it actually used.

projects.description:
Highest usage first; sessions without a recorded working directory are
omitted rather than bucketed as "unknown".

quota.description: Latest quota windows, or absent when the logs contained none.

quotaHistory.description:
Last quota reading per day and window, oldest day first. This is the
history clients persist to estimate weekly depletion.

quotaMinutes.description:
Minute-level quota readings over the trailing hour, oldest first. Clients
estimate short-horizon depletion from this series.

sessionsRoot.description: `None` when this machine has no local Codex installation to read.

UsageTotals.description: Token counters for one day or for the whole window.
